rules.description: Minimum hole diameter constraint for laser cutting
rules.rule: Minimum hole diameter: >= 0.7 x material thickness (Auto calculate if request have radius instead of diameter)
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** Minimum drilling/laser cutting diameter ≥ {{min_diameter}}mm (0.7 x material thickness). This ensures cutting quality, but the file can still be produced. Do you want to continue or modify?

rules.description: Cutout-to-Free-Edge Minimum Distance (Holes, Rectangles, Oblongs, ... any cutout shape)
position_resolution: MANDATORY — Resolve cutout/hole center coordinates BEFORE applying the formula below.
Pattern A — 'hole/cutout at X from edge/corner/side':  center = X  (X is center, not edge)
Pattern B — 'hole/cutout centered / in the center of [face]':  center = face_dim / 2
Pattern C — 'N holes, D mm apart / distance D / spaced D / center-to-center D [on/along axis]':
Pattern D — 'hole/cutout at X from one end, Y from other end':  centers at X and (face_dim - Y)
Pattern E — 'edge-to-edge gap G between holes':  treat as C-to-C = G + diameter, then Pattern C
'each hole/cutout distance D on [axis]' (no 'from edge')  →  Pattern C: C-to-C = D
'hole/cutout [at/from] D from edge/corner'               →  Pattern A: center = D
When genuinely ambiguous: prefer Pattern C (C-to-C), as it is geometrically symmetric.
After resolving: always verify center_near + center_far + 2R <= face_dim (geometry consistency).
rule: SCOPE — check FREE EDGES only; skip BEND EDGES (those are handled by B_05_L/U/Z/TUBE/CAPOT).
Shape              | Face   | Free edges to check (LC_02)  | Bend edges (skip -> B_05)
Sheet              | all    | all 4                         | none
L-Bracket          | base   | 3 (exclude bend toward wall)  | 1 bend
L-Bracket          | wall   | 3 (exclude bend toward base)  | 1 bend
U-Bracket          | base   | 2 (dim_y front/back)          | 2 bends (dim_x left+right)
U-Bracket          | flange | 3 (top + 2 lateral)           | 1 bend (bottom)
Z-Bracket          | top_flange | 3 (top + 2 lateral)       | 1 bend (bottom, toward web)
Z-Bracket          | web    | 2 (lateral length-dir ends)   | 2 bends (top toward top_flange + bottom toward bot_flange)
Z-Bracket          | bot_flange | 3 (bottom + 2 lateral)    | 1 bend (top, toward web)
CAPOT              | base   | NONE — skip LC_02 entirely    | 4 bends (all edges)
CAPOT              | wall   | 3 (top + 2 lateral)           | 1 bend (bottom)
Tube-Rect (bent)   | face   | 2 (length-dir tube ends)      | 2 bends (width-dir corners)
Tube-Rect (welded) | face   | all 4                         | none
FACE_DIM_NOTE — assign face_length and face_width BEFORE applying any formula below:
Definitions:
bend_along_side = the length of the FOLD LINE itself (stated as the folded 'grand côté', e.g. 250mm)
base_length     = the face dimension PERPENDICULAR to the fold line (the remaining dimension, e.g. 120mm)
Axis mapping:
face_length (left↔right, C_x axis) = base_length    (⊥ to fold line)
face_width  (front↔back, C_y axis) = bend_along_side (∥ to fold line)
L-bracket WALL: face_length = bend_along_side, face_width = flange_height
U-bracket BASE: face_length = dim_x (between flanges), face_width = bend_along_side
Sheet (flat)  : face_length = dim_x, face_width = dim_y
⚠️ ORIENTATION AMBIGUITY — CONSERVATIVE CHECK (L-bracket BASE):
When the user does NOT specify which physical edge (left/right vs front/back) is the fold edge:
→ The fold edge is ambiguous. The AI MUST NOT choose the orientation that avoids a violation.
→ Apply CONSERVATIVE RULE: check C_x against min(dim1, dim2) = base_length.
If C_x > base_length: this is a BOUNDARY VIOLATION regardless of orientation.
Reason: at least one valid physical orientation of the part has C_x outside the face.
→ If C_x <= base_length: no boundary issue, continue with normal checks.
⚠️ DO NOT OVERRIDE A CORRECT face_x ASSIGNMENT:
If face_x = base_length is correctly assigned but C_x > face_x:
→ Do NOT re-assign face_x = bend_along_side to make C_x fit.
→ This is a BOUNDARY VIOLATION. Report it immediately.
FORMULAS — apply to each FREE edge independently (skip BEND edges per SCOPE table):
1. For HOLES (Circular Cutouts):
R = diameter / 2
dist = center_from_that_edge - R
VIOLATION if dist < thickness
2. For RECTANGLE Cutouts:
Variables: rect_length, rect_height, C_x=center from left, C_y=center from bottom
dist_left   = C_x - rect_length/2
dist_right  = face_length - C_x - rect_length/2
dist_bottom = C_y - rect_height/2
dist_top    = face_width  - C_y - rect_height/2
Skip bend-edge directions per SCOPE table.
VIOLATION if min(remaining_dists) < thickness
3. For OBLONG (Oval) Cutouts:
Variables: L_ob=total oblong length, W_ob=total oblong width (W_ob < L_ob)
R_ob = W_ob / 2
offset = (L_ob - W_ob) / 2  (semicircle center offset from geometric center)
HORIZONTAL orientation (long axis along face_length):
left_sc  = C_x - offset,  right_sc = C_x + offset
dist_left   = left_sc - R_ob
dist_right  = face_length - right_sc - R_ob
dist_bottom = C_y - R_ob
dist_top    = face_width - C_y - R_ob
Skip bend-edge directions per SCOPE table.
VIOLATION if min(remaining_dists) < thickness

rules.description: Minimum slot width constraint for laser cutting
rules.rule: Minimum slot width: >= 0.7 x material thickness
rules.error_message: **Suggestion:** Slot width must be at least {{min_slot_width}}mm (0.7 x material thickness) for laser cutting. Do you want to continue or modify?

rules.description: User input required for blind hole depth specification
rules.rule: For non-through/blind holes, user must specify hole depth
rules.error_message: Please specify the hole depth for this blind hole.
rules.user_prompt: What is the depth of this blind hole?

rules.description: Thickness constraints for steel in laser cutting (ONLY asked when steel is selected)
rules.rule: Steel thickness: 0.5 mm to 25 mm for laser cutting.
rules.error_message: Steel thickness must be between 0.5 mm and 25 mm for laser cutting.

rules.description: Thickness constraints for stainless steel in laser cutting (ONLY asked when stainless steel is selected)
rules.rule: Stainless steel thickness: 0.5 mm to 20 mm for laser cutting.
rules.error_message: Stainless Steel thickness must be between 0.5 mm and 20 mm for laser cutting.

rules.description: Thickness constraints for aluminum in laser cutting (ONLY asked when aluminum is selected)
